entries.heading: Section 810
ancestors: DIVISION G—DEPARTMENT OF THE INTERIOR, ENVIRONMENT, AND RELATED AGENCIES APPROPRIATIONS ACT, 2022
entries.text:
Sec. 421.  Section 810 
of the Federal Lands Recreation Enhancement Act (16 U.S.C. 6809) shall 
be applied by substituting ``October 1, 2023'' for ``September 30, 
2019''.
